name: Read File
description: Read a text file with line numbers and pagination under the workplace root.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a UTF-8 text file with numbered lines (N|content). Prefer this over cat/head/tail. Use offset+limit for large files; when truncated, continue with the suggested next offset. Suggests similar paths on miss. Paths are relative to the workplace root (absolute OK if under root).

path.description: File path relative to workplace root (or absolute under that root).
